# Knowledge Compiler CLI

The Knowledge Compiler CLI serves as the command-line interface for compiling engineering artifacts into a knowledge base. It provides commands to initialize a repository, compile artifacts, reconcile changes, verify state, inspect details, validate tests, and serve the compiled knowledge for querying.
